mask_roms.source: tools/fetch-rom-elfs.sh roms (espressif/esp-rom-elfs, pinned by SHA-256 in the script)

firmware.sketch: docs/evidence/ble-nearby/ble-scan-probe.ino (EX246), the same builds as EX246's inputs.json
firmware.build: arduino-cli 1.5.1, Arduino-ESP32 core 3.3.12 (ESP-IDF v5.5.5); fqbn esp32:esp32:esp32s3 and esp32:esp32:esp32c3
firmware.not_committed: Plain Arduino builds of the sketch; not added to the repository.

runs.cli-s3: esp32sim --rom roms/esp32s3_rev0_rom.elf --boot rom --board none --flash-mb 4 --bootloader bootloader.bin --ptable partitions.bin --app ble-scan.bin --elf ble-scan.elf --ble --ble-nearby name=Thermo,rssi=-70,addr=c4:aa:01:02:03:04,type=public,rsp=03030f18 --ble-nearby name=Scale,rssi=-82 --console uart0 --max-seconds 8 --no-dump > runs/cli-s3.txt
runs.cli-c3: esp32sim --chip c3 --rom roms/esp32c3_rev3_rom.elf --boot rom --flash-mb 4 --bootloader c3-ble-scan.bootloader.bin --ptable c3-ble-scan.partitions.bin --app c3-ble-scan.bin --elf c3-ble-scan.elf --ble --ble-nearby name=Thermo,rssi=-70,addr=c4:aa:01:02:03:04,type=public,rsp=03030f18 --ble-nearby name=Scale,rssi=-82 --console uart0 --max-seconds 8 --no-dump > runs/cli-c3.txt
runs.page-s3: node ble-nearby-run.mjs web/wasm/esp32sim.wasm none roms/esp32s3_rev0_rom.elf bootloader.bin partitions.bin ble-scan.bin ble-scan.elf plan-static.json 8 > runs/page-s3.txt
runs.page-c3: node ble-nearby-run.mjs web/wasm/esp32sim.wasm esp32c3 roms/esp32c3_rev3_rom.elf c3-ble-scan.bootloader.bin c3-ble-scan.partitions.bin c3-ble-scan.bin c3-ble-scan.elf plan-static.json 8 > runs/page-c3.txt
runs.page-changes: TIMES=1 node ble-nearby-run.mjs ... plan-changes.json 15 > runs/page-{s3|c3}-changes.txt, with the S3 and C3 images as above
runs.compare: the CLI's stdout against the page's uart: lines, CR and empty lines dropped: identical on both chips
runs.module: web/wasm/esp32sim.wasm from tools/wasm-build.sh on this commit
